newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-CAMINERO LEADS ATLETICO TO EMPHATIC VICTORY ON RETURN.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-CAMINERO LEADS ATLETICO TO EMPHATIC VICTORY ON RETURN.

text.p: Atletico Madrid playmaker Jose Luis Caminero celebrated his comeback from injury with a well-taken goal which put the Spanish champions on the way to a 3-0 victory over Oviedo on Sunday.
Atletico move into provisional sixth place, nine points behind leaders Barcelona who play Sporting Gijon on Monday.
Valladolid continued to surprise the pundits by moving up to fourth place with a 4-2 win at Valencia, while struggling Sevilla beat Athletic Bilbao by the same score.
A 2-1 victory at Zaragoza was enough to give Deportivo Coruna provisional second place ahead of Real Madrid's game at Compostela, which kicked off late.
